summary: One and One Green Technologies (Nasdaq: YDDL), a Philippines-based non-ferrous metals recycler, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its participation in the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, held September 14-16, 2026 at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. CEO Tina Yan and CFO Willis Wong will hold investor meetings. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms were disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations event notice, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is nil, with attention instead on any capital-markets activity that could follow.
